build_commands: if command -v install_name_tool >/dev/null 2>&1; then for f in "$TSI_INSTALL_DIR"/lib/libicu*.dylib; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; for dep in $(otool -L "$f" | awk 'NR>1 && $1 !~ /^[\/@]/ {print $1}'); do [ -f "$TSI_INSTALL_DIR/lib/$dep" ] && install_name_tool -change "$dep" "$TSI_INSTALL_DIR/lib/$dep" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; done; done; fi
